finalText:
Confirmed: `package.json` still pins `fast-parse` at `1.4.2`, the version `NOTES.md` says was yanked over a prototype-pollution report. `1.4.3` is the fix, and nothing was bumped.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, worst first:

1. `src/routes/internal.js` — no auth at all, left open when the VPN was retired.
2. `src/repo/report.js` — SQL injection through string-built queries.
3. `config/staging.js` — a live database password committed in plaintext.
4. `package.json` — `fast-parse` still on the yanked, vulnerable `1.4.2`.

The verify script confirms it: all four findings pass, and no service file was touched.
